title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, persist the pending verdict at the SECOND of two pending-sk
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, persist the pending verdict at the SECOND of two pending-skip sites. A previous change patched the wrong one and is inert.

THERE ARE TWO SIMILAR SITES. Do not confuse them:
- Site A, already patched, DO NOT TOUCH: its console.log contains the parenthetical text `(landed once, unmeasured)` and it is already followed by an `await markPendingVerification(...)` call.
- Site B, the one to patch: its console.log has NO parenthetical.

ANCHOR. This exact line is site B and occurs EXACTLY ONCE in the file:
    console.log(`[gap-to-feature] gap ${String(gap.id ?? '')} PENDING verification at pick time — skipping re-compose`);

ONE OPERATION. On the line IMMEDIATELY AFTER that console.log, and before the `return {` that follows it, insert exactly this statement:

    await markPendingVerification(gap, undefined, "pending at pick time (site B): landed once, no measurement predicate — persisted so the candidate filter can exclude it");

Change nothing else. Do not modify site A. Do not modify the console.log, the return value, the enclosing `if (_pickCond === 'pending') {`, the comment above it, the top of the file, or any import.

WHY SITE B SPECIFICALLY. Measured over two consecutive windows on an idle box: site B's log line fired 13 times while site A's fired 0 times. Site B is the branch that actually executes for the gaps currently blocking the compose lane. The previous fix went to site A, which never runs, so it changed nothing.

WHY. `_pickCond` is recomputed by verifyGapCondition on every pick, and for a gap with a landed commit and no measurement predicate it returns 'pending' every time, so the pick is discarded. This branch writes nothing back, while the picker's candidate-set exclusion filters on the STORED `classification_metadata.disposition`. That is a closed loop: the picker ranks the gap top, this branch discards the cycle, nothing is persisted, the exclusion filter stays blind, and the same gap wins again next tick.

MEASURED IMPACT, two consecutive windows at loadavg ~3 with zero compose-cap refusals, so this is not contention: 25 picks / 25 skipped / 0 composes, then 13 picks / 13 skipped / 0 composes. Both windows resolved to the same FOUR gap ids out of 817 open gaps, and all four carry `disposition: None` in the store — the pick-time check knows they are pending and the store does not. The compose lane produced zero executions in either window.

WHY THIS IS SAFE. It does not change what this branch decides and does not re-enable composing these gaps; the skip and the returned `pending_verification` report are untouched. It only records the verdict already reached, via the same module-scope helper `markPendingVerification` that is already awaited at several other call sites in this file, including site A.
